objective: macro mean of per-query (class@5 + D1@5 + D2@5 + D5@5)/4
relevance: same original ND1 categorical label; class uses ND1 six scene classes; D1 uses original metadata dominant_group (five groups obtained by mapping the argmax of eight pixel shares), with eight-color detail retained
constraint: class P@5 >= maximum development class P@5 across the declared grid minus SE of that reference configuration
selection: within constrained configs, objective >= best constrained objective minus its SE; choose fewest nonzero weights, then largest CLIP, then lexicographically smallest HSV/LBP/motion
split: half groups within each class; development for selection, test only for final metrics; gallery all indexed videos excluding query itself
se: class macro with within-class cluster-sum SE; objective formed per query to retain covariance
groups: optional video_id,group CSV; default each video is a group, which does not certify absence of near duplicates
ablation: four single descriptors, chosen weights, four leave-one-out; renormalize remaining weights without retuning
random_baseline: exact expected same-label fraction in whole gallery excluding query, macro over the actual query split
flow_score: 1 - symmetric_chi_square/3; three original L1 blocks preserved
test_policy: one sealed test execution after weight lock; no tuning based on test; no claim that 1-SE is a significance test
